# Three.js

Three.js r175 (0.175.0), MIT. The two distribution modules, Reflector helper,
and license were copied from the existing local `liquid-worlds/vendor`
directory. Reflector imports the local distribution rather than a package/CDN.
Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r175
No runtime CDN, fonts, assets, analytics, or network dependencies.
